Use case: precise-object-edit. Finish the Cold Food Festival (寒食) banner by correcting ONLY the two background issues below.

Input image 1 = approved primary painting style, chibi identity and horizontal banner reference (Mid-Autumn source, STYLE ONLY).
Input image 2 = approved mail UI painting-quality reference (STYLE ONLY; ignore all words, frames and controls).
Input image 3 = the Cold Food Festival candidate to EDIT. Keep the 2098 x 749 native canvas and approximately 2.8:1 banner.

2. Make the LEFT 45 percent genuinely calm negative space for future native text: a broad smooth jade-blue lake, a pale airy sky and only a few softly layered distant teal hill silhouettes with light mist. Remove the dense buildings, bridges, waterfalls and sharply detailed foreground foliage from this left zone. Keep the left side softly colored and quieter than the right; no flat white blank rectangle, no artificial blur panel or graphic border. Blend the transition naturally into the center and preserve the detailed right-side picnic.

Maintain precisely the current image's polished rounded hand-painted 2D fantasy finish, luminous clean daylight and readable ivory cloth folds. Do not redesign the boy or change the food, hands, feet, basket or flask. Keep everything fully within the canvas. No text, letters, numerals, writing, watermark, interface or frame. No rabbit, moon, mooncakes, osmanthus, steam, smoke, fire, flame, cooking stove, grave or frightening imagery. This is a calm spring Cold Food Festival outing with cold picnic food and fresh willow leaves.

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final independent traditional Chinese festival event banner for the Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: target native 2098 × 749 pixels, very wide landscape 2.8:1, opaque edge-to-edge illustration. Never a whole interface or a contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY approved style, chibi-character and horizontal-composition reference. Input image 2 is the approved mail interface context; use its painting quality only, never copy UI frames, borders, controls or writing.
Preserve the reference's refined rounded Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: precise polished contours, full rounded shapes, rich but restrained painterly detail, convincing cloth/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal landscape, ivory cloth, warm gold accents, clean air and soft depth. Luminous but properly exposed highlights. Premium 2D illustration, not flat vector or plastic 3D.
Character on the RIGHT THIRD: one small chibi Taoist boy, the same large brown eyes, rosy round face, short spiky brown hair, golden headband with knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd on belt. Big head and short limbs. Keep his face, hands and all important props within safe edges.
LEFT 45% stays comparatively quiet: softly layered distant scenery and mist or sky, suitable for future overlaid text, but do not paint any text. Foreground thematic props concentrate on the right. Do not place the character on the left.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no Chinese or English characters, pseudo-writing, numerals, calligraphy, watermark, logo, UI border, graphic frame. Plain lanterns and plain packets must have NO characters. No giant moon, mooncakes, rabbit or Mid-Autumn osmanthus. Change the scene to the festival below instead of copying the reference night setting.
Rendering goal: highest available refined finished painting; the host manages the model and quality.
Festival-specific scene: Theme: Cold Food Festival (寒食). A calm daylight spring outing beneath young willow branches. On the right the boy sits on a low grassy stone and presents a bamboo picnic basket with smooth green qingtuan rice cakes and pale cold pastries on an ivory cloth. A small closed porcelain tea flask beside the basket; no steam, fire, flames or cooking stove anywhere. Fresh pale green willow leaves, a few white blossoms, distant clear misty teal hills and quiet lake on the left. Gentle remembrance and spring freshness, tasteful and peaceful, no graves or horror.

checks.theme: 嫩柳、青团、米白冷糕、竹篮与封口瓷壶表现春日寒食，夜色、月轮、桂花及玉兔已移除。
checks.style: 保持参考的大头短身道童、纯金发带、玉绿米白衣装、暖金葫芦及圆润精修手绘体积。
checks.face: 两只大眼、五官和耳部自然，未见扭曲。
checks.hands: 双手自然托握青团，手与食物接触合理，未见可见多指、断接或融合；部分指头被青团及握姿遮挡，不能声称完整逐手数到五指。
checks.feet: 两只鞋完整可见，与坐姿和腿部连接合理，未见多足或裁切。
checks.propsContact: 篮筐、冷点和瓷壶由石台/布面支撑，未见漂浮或明显穿插。
checks.negativeSpace: 左约45%为天空、湖面、低对比远山与薄雾，底边少量花叶；为安静自然场景留白，不是纯色空白。
checks.text: 未见文字、伪字、水印、标志、UI框或拼图。
checks.forbiddenMotifs: 未见动物、火、烹饪灶、食物热气、坟墓或恐怖元素；湖山远处薄雾是环境气氛。
checks.exposure: 整体明亮，米白衣褶、面部、金饰及云层保持明暗层次，无明显大片过曝。

limitations: 可见区域视觉检查通过，不宣称被遮挡手指可完整计数。
本次仅静态美术与文件验收，不代表新增节日已导入 Unity 或上线。
